kind.description:
The namespace kind the top-level namespace takes, naming a `namespaceKinds` entry giving its boundary facts.
@default its config `kind` at the root, its directory name in a workspace; ignored below a top-level namespace

imports.description:
Top-level namespaces of the same scope the top-level namespace imports besides its kind's `imports`, by name, with a relation: `whole` any file, `surface` only a domain's `index`, `entry` and public roles.
A relation stronger than its kind's replaces it; the target kind's `inward` caps it, and a sealed target is reported and ignored.
`{ relation, dirs }` reaches only the listed directories of the target, relative to the scope, whatever grants its kind's `imports` give; a directory the target does not span is reported and ignored.
@default only its kind's `imports`; ignored below a top-level namespace

layers.description:
Order of the namespace's children, lowest first, with `*` for every child not listed. Unset, the children are unordered peers.
@default none

relation.description:
How children of one layer reach each other: `peers` through their `index.ts`, or `isolated`, never. Children of a namespace without `layers` all count as one layer. Unset, `peers`.
@default none

children.description:
What every child directory of the namespace is: `domains` makes each one a domain, without an `index.ts` or a `domains` entry. Unset, children are classified from their contents.
@default none

purpose.description:
One line stating what the namespace groups.
@default none

debt.description:
Why the member does not fit the project's Compass, such as the earlier decision it stands on: agents decouple it at each opportunity and never take it as precedent.
@default none

enable.description: Roles of the environment to turn on for the whole subtree of the namespace, by name.

roles.description: Scoped roles the namespace enables. In a directory of a namespace spanning several, the only place that directory's roles are enabled.
